shortDescription: Install or uninstall overlay additional packages

options.name: apply_live
options.description: Adds the options C(--apply-live) when O(state=present). Option is ignored when O(state=absent). For more information, please see U(https://coreos.github.io/rpm-ostree/apply-live/).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of overlay package to install or remove.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the overlay package. V(present) simply ensures that a desired package is installed. V(absent) removes the specified package.
